description: This bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," displays accuracy scores for three different evaluation methods—labeled in the legend as "Base" (red), "RMU with Enhanced GCG" (light green), and "RMU" (light yellow)—across two distinct tasks: "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval." The vertical y-axis represents "Accuracy," scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.6, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The horizontal x-axis presents the two tasks, with "MCQ Eval" on the left and "Generation Eval" on the right. For each task, the bars are stacked, with the "Base" method forming the bottom layer, the "RMU" method forming the middle layer, and the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" method forming the top layer. The chart shows that for "MCQ Eval," the "Base" method achieved an accuracy of 0.644, the "RMU" method achieved 0.299, and the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" method achieved 0.539. For "Generation Eval," the "Base" method achieved an accuracy of 0.597, the "RMU" method achieved 0.106, and the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" method achieved 0.263. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the tasks as labeled on the x-axis.
